mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate reduces the cost of capital for corporations, increasing the present value of future cash flows and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 4.8% signals strengthening labor market conditions, which typically precedes corporate hiring and higher earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE falls below 4.8%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in residential construction (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) signals robust aggregate demand, which typically leads to higher corporate profits and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce positive 60-day returns in more than 55% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 2.5% year-over-year), the Federal Reserve is likely to tighten monetary policy, which increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index (INDPRO) indicates expanding manufacturing output, which typically correlates with stronger corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO is rising.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly housing starts above 2050.0 thousand units signals strong residential construction activity, which typically precedes higher consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST exceeds 2050.0.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in employment (PAYEMS) and declining unemployment (UNRATE) signals a tight labor market, which typically leads to higher wage growth and corporate profit margins, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising PAYEMS and falling UNRATE fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of declining industrial production (INDPRO < 118.0), manufacturing sector weakness is likely to reduce corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO falls below 118.0.
